notes.title: Falcon returns home
notes.content:
Falcon has officially returned to MicroProse's line-up (you can read more at "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/microprose/announcements/detail/3680047495733505345]MicroProse is back on the Falcon series[/url]"), and as part of this new era we've made a few changes to the classic Falcon packages. For Falcon Gold, you can now enjoy the following:

[list]
[*] Our classic games launcher, where you can choose the game to play (including the amazing Art of the Kill videos!) or comfortably change different options for a more accurate or nostalgic experience.
[*] New and improved documentation, including the original Falcon 3.0 Manual and Reference Card. Manuals and extras for [i]MiG-29: Deadly Adversary of Falcon 3.0[/i], [i]Hornet: Naval Strike Fighter[/i] and [i]Operation: Fighting Tiger[/i] are coming at a later date, so stay tuned!
[/list]
We hope you enjoy these improvements as much as we did making them! We plan to continue improving the experience, so let us know if you have any feedback.

notes.title: Falcon 4.0 Update
notes.content:
Falcon 4.0 is now more stable with current OS's! This update fixes an issue where the game prompts you to insert a CD prior to launch. Note: please reinstall the game for the update to go into effect. 

As a celebration for the Falcon series, we've added trading cards to both Falcon Gold and Falcon 4.0 for everyone who purchased these games individually or as a collection to enjoy! 

Also, a new Falcon 4.0 T-shirt is now available on [url=http://www.amazon.com/retroism?channel=steam]Amazon[/url]! 

[url=http://www.amazon.com/retroism?channel=steam] [img]http://retroism.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/Falcon-T-Shirt-on-Steam-DO-NOT-DELETE.png[/img][/url]
